ATV 占用数 MHz 宽带，DATV 用压缩编码大幅降低码率。: ATV occupies several MHz, while DATV uses compression coding to greatly reduce the bit rate.
ATV 带宽大，需确认操作证允许的频段与发射类别。: ATV is wide, so confirm the bands and emission classes your licence allows.
Amateur Television，业余电视，快速扫描传送运动图像。: Amateur Television: fast-scan transmission of moving images.
DATV 常用软件（如 DATV Express）配合 SDR 或专用调制器。: DATV commonly uses software (such as DATV Express) together with an SDR or a dedicated modulator.
Digital Amateur Television，基于 DVB-S / DV: Digital Amateur Television: digital television based on DVB-S / DVB-T.
Slow-Scan Television，慢扫描静止图像（话音带宽内）。: Slow-Scan Television: still images at slow scan (within the voice bandwidth).
国际空间站不定期开展 SSTV 活动，是入门图像接收的好机会。: The ISS runs SSTV events from time to time — a good chance to start receiving images.
常用 UHF（如 430 / 1200MHz）及以上微波频段。: Usually UHF (e.g. 430 / 1200 MHz) and microwave bands above.
电视信号对失真与干扰敏感，注意功放线性与馈线质量。: Television signals are sensitive to distortion and interference; mind amplifier linearity and feedline quality.
